tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i nor sgrub gter gyi bum pa bzhugs so:

EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s rigs kyi ḍākki lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: :slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i nor sgrub gter gyi bum pa zhes bya ba 'di bsgrub pa'i rdzas la: ka pā la dum bu gcig pa: dbus na gshong bu bzhi 'dug pa na de 'dod 'jo'i ba yin te: mdun na gshong bu gsum 'dug na yid bzhin gyi nor bu yin no: dpag bsam gyi shing la 'bras bu chags pa: mdun zur mtho ba: ltag zur 'jam pa: dbyibs legs pa de lta bu'i thod pa mtshan ldan la nang du padma 'dab brgyad: lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bri: sman sna dang : byang sems sbyar bas padma 'dab brgyad la yab yum brgyad kyi snying po bri: mu khyud la sgrub pa'i sngags bri: lte ba la gtso bo'i sa bon dang dngos grub kyi spel tshig bri: de'i steng du yab yum rnams so sor bri: tshon legs par bkye la spra rtsis mnan la chus mi 'jig pa bya'o: de'i nang du bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu dang : dri dang : sman dang : ratna dang : 'bru sna dang : gos dang : zas sna tshogs pas bkang la stegs bu legs pa'i steng du bzhag: dar dmar pos gril la mi phyug po g.yang can gyi phyugs kyi spu'i the gus gzungs thag byas la thod pa la dkris la gdag go: de nas lha bskyed pa ni thod pa ḍākki'i gzhal yas khang du bskyed la: nang du lha tshogs thams cad bskyed la rang dpa' bo rta mgrin yab yum du bskyed la sngags bzlas so: oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hrī ya: ba su siddhi: na na kha dhe siddhi: sarba siddhi pha la hūṃ: siddhi siddhi sa ma ya sdu?s sdus hūṃ hūṃ zhes bzlas so: ting nge 'dzin ni: bdag dpa' bo rta mgrin yab yum gyi thugs ka nas thod pa'i nang gi lha tshogs la 'od 'phros pas: ḍākki ma'i srog thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas ḍākki ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas: srid pa gsum dang gling bzhi'i lha 'dre mi gsum gyi nor bu gyur pa thams cad dang :

sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang lha 'dre mi gsum gyi srog dang yon tan thams cad bsdus nas thod pa'i nang gi rdzas la bstim mo: gzhan yang dngos grub kyi rdzas zas kyi rnam pa ci mang du bshams shing bstims la: sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi spro bsdu nus tshad bya'o: gtor ma sna tshogs pa ci mang du bshams la ḍākki ma la 'bul zhing bskang ngo : de nas ḍākki ma nor la bskul zhing dngos grub blangs te 'khar rnga dang : ting ting shags dang thod rnga dkrol zhing dbyangs snyan pos 'bod do: hūṃ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro gnas nas bzhengs: mkha' 'gro rigs lnga gnas nas bzhengs: mnyam nyid dbyings nas sku bskyod 'tshal: rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo: gser gyi gdu bu si li li: rgyan cha mang po pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: rin chen dgos 'dod spungs se spung : dngos grub sna tshogs chi li li: phyi nang dngos grub zad mi mnga': sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya ba su siddhi na na kha dhe siddhi sarba siddhi pha la hūṃ: siddhi siddhi sa ma ya sdus sdus hūṃ hūṃ: zhes bzlas so: hūṃ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro gnas nas bzhengs: mkha' 'gro sde drug gnas nas bzhengs: bde chen gnas nas sku bskyod 'tshal: rin chen rgyan cha sogs gong gis 'gres so: oṃ āḥhūṃ oṃ (< a > yoṃ ) hriṃ mo hring hring hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa: ba su siddhi siddhi: na na kha dhe: siddhi siddhi pha la hūṃ: siddhi siddhi sa ma ya sdus sdus hūṃ hūṃ: hūṃ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro gnas nas bzhengs: kha gdong la sogs mkha' 'gro rnams: sgo bzhi'i gnas nas sku bskyod 'chal: rin chen la sogs 'gre'o: oṃ āḥhūṃḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: ba su siddhi la sogs 'gre'o: hūṃ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro gnas nas bzhengs: mkha' 'gro nyer brgyad gnas nas bzhengs: dur khrod gnas nas sku=

rin chen= oṃ āḥhūṃ: hūṃ maṃ hrī ha: hūṃ ma hrī ha: ba su la sogs 'gre'o: zhes bskul bas: mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dngos grub char ltar phab par bsam: grub pa'i rtags ni: rab ḍākki mas dngos grub ci 'dod zer du 'ong : dkar mo byung na zhi ba'i dngos grub: ser mo byung na rgyas pa'i dngos grub: smug mo byung na dbang gi dngos grub: nag mo byung na drag po'i dngos grub thob bo: 'bring nyams su 'ong ste tshe thogs pa byung na tshe'i dngos grub: dar thogs pa byung na gos kyi dngos grub: ratna thogs pa byung na nor gyi dngos grub: mda' thogs pa byung na mi'i dngos grub: sngags zlos shing byung na nus mthu'i dngos grub: po ti khyer nas byung na chos kyi dngos grub: me long ston cing byung na rtogs pa'i dngos grub: thod pa chang gis bkang ba byung na mchog gi dngos grub: thod pa khrag gis bkang ba byung na thun mong gi dngos grub: thod pa lcang lo can bdud rtsis bkang ba khyer byung na dngos grub gnyis ka 'thob bo: tha ma rmi lam du 'ong ste ma ru byas nas zas nor ster na ma ltar byams te dngos grub thob: sring mo ltar byas te zas nor ster na sring ltar gdung ste dngos grub thob: chung ma ltar byas te zas nor ster na grogs ltar brtse ste dngos grub thob: mdza' mo ltar byas te zas nor ster na gsang thub snying nye ste dngos grub thob: bran mo ltar byas te zas nor ster na shin tu nyan pas dngos grub myur du thob: btsun mor byas na dbang du 'dus par dka' ste che btsan grags pa'i dngos grub thob bo: rje mor byung na las bkol dka' ste brgyud 'dzin rigs kyi dngos grub thob: yugs sar byung na dam tshig nyams pa dang mi gtsang ba yod pas khrus dang bskang bshags bya: sbrang mor byung na thugs dam mi bskangs pas tshogs gtor gyis thugs dam bskang ngo : pho tshogs su byung nas dngos grub ster na:

dngos grub myur bar 'ong ste bar chad yong nyen yod pas yi dam bsnyen pas drag tu gcun no: mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub ni: mi 'du: nor 'du: zas 'du: chos 'du: ḍākki mas byin gyis brlab ste chos kyi bdag por 'gyur ro: mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub yong bar gyur na: rang dpa' bo yab yum du bsgom: yum gyi pad ma la: dbus na 'dab ma bzhi la mo yig bzhi bsam: yab la dbus na hrī: 'dab ma bzhi la pho yig bzhi bsgoms la: 'gro ba lha mi thams cad mkha' 'gro pho mor bsgom: de dag gi snying pad ma 'dab bzhi la pho thams cad la pho yig lnga bsam: mo thams cad la mo yig lnga bsam: snying la 'khor lo bskor bas mi thams cad snying 'gul par bsams la: sngags 'dis mi snying sgul lo: oṃ āḥhūṃ: hrī ma ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hrī ya: sgul sgul: ma ma hring hring : ma ma kha shi: mi snying sgul sgul: mi 'gram chog chog: hring hring sdus sdus: ma ma kha shi baṃ swā hā: ṇī a kar sha ya dza: ṇī a kar sha ya hrī: zhes bzlas shing snang ba dbang du 'dus par bsam mo: ḍākki la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: rgya shug la sogs pa la me spar la: phye mar dang zas sna tshogs bsreg cing me'i nang du ḍākki yab yum bskyed la zhal du mchod pa yang yang 'bul: sngags gong ma bzlas: zas nor 'du bar 'gyur na: zas tshogs: gtor tshogs: me tshogs bya: mi pho mo thams cad kyi snying 'gul nas 'du'o: mkha' 'gro ma thams cad mtsho la ngang ngur 'du ba bzhin du 'du 'ong ngo : slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis: jo mo mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gyi don du mdzad pa: mkha' 'gro ma'i nor sgrub gter gyi bum pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dge'o: rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa them nas: rab kyis zhag bdun: 'bring gis nyi shu: tha mas kyang zla ba gcig na 'grub nges so: gdon mi za'o: : mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/
